tonight.headline: 0-3, and this week's opponent is the Lamar trade partner
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 118.8 against Team 13's 111.8, a 53% chance. No starter is in doubt.
One lineup tap: Golden into the flex over Tate, because the projection says so, not for any other reason. And don't send the Lamar offer this week. It would add 4.3 points to the team you're playing.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 start Josh Allen, QUESTIONABLE with a knee contusion that Dr. Chao expects him to play through (SI, 28 Sep). If he sits, Lamar starts for them, and they lose little.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An injury on Friday's report for Taylor, Barkley, Rice or Wilson. None is listed today.

doFirst.title: Start Golden in the flex over Tate
doFirst.subtitle: A one-point coin flip. The rule is to take the projection, so this is a tap, not a thesis.

case.label: The call
case.body: Golden 12.9, Tate 11.9. Inside the two-point line, where even ESPN is right only 56% of the time. Take the projection.

case.label: The one fact
case.body: Jayden Reed (neck) likely misses a second game and LaFleur had no update (RotoWire, 28 Sep). Golden drew 12 targets in Weeks 1 and 3. Tate drew 9 in Week 3, behind Wan'Dale Robinson.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate outscores Golden. It's a coin flip, so that happens often and changes nothing about the rule.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · not today · add free after Wed 01:00 if he clears · before Sun 07:30
doFirst.title: If Downs clears: add him free, drop Lloyd
doFirst.subtitle: Lloyd is Green Bay's third back. Downs leads the Colts in targets with Pierce on IR. Never spend priority on this.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Lloyd, 67.6% rostered, so this goes against the market on the record. He's Green Bay's RB3: 15 snaps in Week 3 to Brooks' 27 and Kaleb Johnson's 24 (Acme Packing Co.), 4 carries in the archive, 6.5 projected. His hold thesis is closed WRONG today.

case.label: The add
case.body: Downs drew 11 targets in Week 3, the team lead, with Alec Pierce on IR (heel) (Heavy, 27 Sep). The waiver tool has him RISING, 6 to 13.5 to 16.5 opportunities, and he projects 13.7.

case.label: The price
case.body: He's on WAIVERS until Wed 01:00 Mexico City. IPADE priority never resets and Bloodsports are 6th, so he's only an add as a free agent after he clears. If someone claims him, Michael Wilson (17 targets in Week 3) is the same move on the same terms.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Downs draws under five targets against Washington, or Lloyd outscores Downs in two of the next three weeks.

doFirst.sources: Heavy · Acme Packing Co. · Week 3 archive

action.label: Add Downs · drop Lloyd (only after Wed 01:00, only if he cleared)

whatWentWrong.title: Lloyd is Green Bay's third back, and his seat is dead
whatWentWrong.lead: Kept on the theory that Jacobs' absence made him the lead. He had 4 carries in Week 3 and played the fewest snaps of the three.

case.label: The archive
case.body: Touches: Week 2, Lloyd 8, Johnson 8, Brooks 6. Week 3, Lloyd 7, Johnson 7, Brooks 1. The written falsifier ('out-touched two weeks running') never fired because they tied. The thesis was about the lead role, and the snaps say he isn't it. Closed WRONG; the falsifier was badly written.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Downs card above.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Josh Jacobs reinstated. No reinstatement found (29 Sep), and that would cut into Lloyd's role anyway.

whatWentWrong.title: Lost 98.8 to 121.5; 17.2 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: The best lineup from this roster was 116.0, so the week wasn't winnable. Golden scored 21.0 on the bench while Tate scored 11.8 in the flex.

case.label: The archive
case.body: Tuten 17.0 for Barkley 9.0, Golden 21.0 for Tate 11.8. Last week the projection had Tate over Golden by 0.4, a coin flip, and it went the other way. This week the projection flips to Golden by 1.0.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the method. Coin flips follow the projection in both directions, which is the Golden card.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A lineup call this week that follows last week's points. None does.

lineupCheck.verdict: One coin flip: the projection starts Golden (12.9) over Tate (11.9) in the flex. Take the projection and write no thesis. No starter is in doubt.

moves.reason: COIN FLIP (1.0): the projection, not news. No thesis, no decision-log entry.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +4.3 a week: Tuten (12.7) would start over Rachaad White (8.4), and Lamar scores them nothing behind Allen. Bigger than yours, which is why it's worth sending — but not this week, when they're your opponent.

case.label: Their surplus
case.body: Re-checked on the 12:48 snapshot: Lamar at slot 20 behind Josh Allen at slot 0; McCaffrey and White start at RB (slot 2), Blake Corum (8.1) on the bench.

case.label: Your gain
case.body: Lamar 20.3 against Lawrence's 17.5: +2.8 a week. Tuten is your third back and doesn't start. Season projections: Lamar 269.7, Tuten 179.8.

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: Team 13 are your Week 4 opponent. If they accepted before Sunday, their +4.3 comes straight out of your matchup against your +2.8. So send it after Monday night, not before. Allen's knee contusion is the other risk: if he missed time, Lamar becomes their starter and the surplus disappears.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back over White, drop or trade a quarterback, or Allen misses time. Don't send until Week 4 is final.

trades.copyText: Hi — after this week's game, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar can't start for you behind Allen, and Tuten (12.7 projected) would start over White for you, about +4 a week on your side.

worthALook.name: Michael Wilson
worthALook.lead: Second choice for the Lloyd seat, on the same free-agent-only terms as Downs.

case.label: The role
case.body: Seventeen targets and 11-89-1 in Week 3 (NBC, 27 Sep), while Marvin Harrison Jr. drew under 10% of Arizona's targets (NBC).

case.label: Why second
case.body: Downs' volume has a structural reason, Pierce on IR. Wilson's is one week of a changed pecking order. Both are on WAIVERS until Wed 01:00, and neither is worth priority.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Downs claimed by someone else, and Wilson clearing. Then add Wilson free for Lloyd.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: Myers 9.7, Pineiro 9.2 this week. In Week 3: Myers 9, Pineiro 6 with two missed PATs.

case.label: Why hold
case.body: Myers is on WAIVERS. 0.5 points isn't worth never-resetting priority.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Myers clears to free agency and the gap reaches two points.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: Steelers 8.2 and Bills 8.1 against the 49ers' 6.4. Bosa is ruled out again (RotoWire, 28 Sep).

case.label: Why hold
case.body: 1.8 points, under the two-point bar, and both alternatives cost priority until they clear. Pittsburgh also play Thursday, so the unit locks early.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If either clears to free agency Wednesday and the gap is still near two points. Then it's a free swap.

case.body: He'd be your fourth back behind Taylor, Barkley and Tuten, at 9.3. A claim drops Bloodsports from 6th to last for the season.

case.label: What would change it

doNotChase.name: Colston Loveland
doNotChase.lead: Dropped three days ago. Reclaiming him would reverse a move inside the churn window, and cost priority.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Projects 10.0 to Gadsden's 7.1. Four catches on four targets Monday with Case Keenum starting (archive); Williams has a grade 2 hamstring and is out 3–4 weeks (CBS).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3, 3 and 4 targets in three games. He's on WAIVERS, and reversing a move made on 26 Sep hasn't gained anything the two times it's happened on this roster.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: He clears to free agency and Gadsden stays under four targets. Then it's a free swap after the window closes.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nine risers and one faller from three weeks of data, still thin. One riser has a role reason that holds and a seat to go into: Downs, for Lloyd, as a free agent only. Wilson is second. The rest are injury fill-ins or one-week spikes, and IPADE priority is never spent on those.
